changes.headline: Size limit updated
details: size limit is now No size limit (was none stated)

changes.headline: Size limit and Bag limit updated
details: size limit is now No size limit (was none stated)
bag limit is now 2 per harvester per day; 10 per vessel per day (was 2  per day)

changes.headline: Permits updated
details: license/permit requirements are now: Federal HMS Angling Permit is required when fishing in state and federal waters.; Anglers targeting bluefin tuna, bigeye tuna, albacore tuna, yellowfin tuna and skipjack tuna are required to have a federal HMS Angling Permit.

changes.headline: Bag limit updated
details: Atlantic federal waters: bag limit is now 3 per harvester per day [anglers fishing from private recreational vessels]; 5 per harvester per day [for-hire vessels] (was 3 per harvester [anglers fishing from private recreational vessels]; 5 per harvester [for-hire vessels])
Atlantic state waters: bag limit is now 3 per harvester per day [Nassau through Miami-Dade counties] (was 3 per harvester [Nassau through Miami-Dade counties])
Gulf state and federal waters: bag limit is now 10 per harvester per day (was 10 per harvester [includes Monroe County])

changes.headline: Season and Bag limit updated
details: season is now Catch and release only (FWC Commissioners approved measures making bonefish catch-and-release only, effective Sept. 1, 2013.) (was Catch and release only (Bonefish harvest is prohibited statewide; catch-and-release only.))
bag limit is now 0 per harvester (was none stated)

changes.headline: Bag limit updated
details: bag limit is now 1 per harvester per day; 4 per vessel [recreational (not for-hire) vessel]; 15 per vessel [for-hire vessel]; 6 per vessel [Charter boats]; 0 per harvester per day [captain and crew of for-hire vessels] (was 1 per harvester per day; 4 per vessel per day [recreational (not for-hire) vessel]; 15 per vessel per day [for-hire vessel]; 6 per vessel per day [Charter boats]; Catch and release only; 0 per harvester per day [captain and crew of for-hire vessels])
